_what: Literals that LOOK like DynamoDB table names but are not AWS resources.
_why: tools/iam_scan_sources.py refuses to classify a relayshield_* literal as a table unless it appears in a table context. Everything else lands in 'unclassified' so a human looks at it once. This file records that look, so the same strings are not re-reviewed every run. Adding a name here grants nothing -- it only suppresses a prompt. If a name here ever DOES become a table, delete it from this file.
